messages:
anika: Quick alert 18:00 UTC change window today. Planning to flip lumen-6b-v3 into unpinned catalog routing for HOSTED. Dedicated remains opt-in unless tenant unpinned.

Tom: ack. Whats our fallback ordering and pin precedence?

anika: Fallback ladder = lumen-6b-v3 -> lumen-6b-v3-quant -> lumen-6b-legacy-6b-v2. Pins override rollout (highest precedence).

frank: Ops requirement: ensure dedicated pin-backstop is active. If customer has a pin record, do not change their effective model. Docs PR #501 updates the pinbackstop section.

maya: Good catch. Also adding a safety net: an allowlist toggle per region in case ap-southeast gets tight.

deploybot: Preflight summary: artifacts OK, quant profiles validated, healthchecks pass, canary config ready. Command preview: `deploybot start-rollout --model lumen-6b-v3 --env hosted --canary 5 --steps 5,20,50 --eu-hold true`

ops-bot: infra check: us-west-2 healthy, eu-west-1 healthy, ap-southeast-1 at 12% spare capacity. Recommend slower ramp in APAC.

Tom: Let's add thresholds: auto-rollback if p95 > 600ms or total_error_rate > 0.8% sustained 7m. Also quality gate: if eval winrate vs v2 drops by 3+ points on quickset, abort.

anika: Agreed. Final thresholds: p95 >= 600ms OR error_rate >= 0.8% for 7m OR eval_winrate_drop >= 3.0% for two consecutive runs. Deploybot will enact the fallback ladder to lumen-6b-legacy-6b-v2 on trigger.

frank: EU manual checkpoint: pause at first 5% canary until @maya gives ack (5-minute observation). Global ramp only after ack.

maya: I'll be on standby. We'll stream evals from `/evals/lumen/quick-ab` and run synthetic latency load.

deploybot: Canary started at 2765432120. Telemetry: https://console.redwood/rollouts/2765432101. Running synthetic prompts set alpha.

Tom: Watching dashboard. small p95 bump in ap-southeast but within 600ms. errors stable ~0.25%.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot: p50=210ms, p95=480ms, error_rate=0.27% (5m). APAC p95=590ms.

frank: APAC headroom borderline. Recommend halting APAC ramp stage until 10% spare capacity confirmed.

anika: Pausing APAC ramp. Proceeding with US/EU stages only.

maya: Eval quickset results: winrate delta = +0.6% (v3 vs v2). No quality regression.

deploybot: Canary progress: 5% -> 5% (EU hold) -> 20% in US. APAC paused.

Tom: All good from infra side. If EU ack not received in 10m, we'll abort EU rollout and notify stakeholders.

maya: ACK EU now. Continue with EU ramp to 20%.

ops-bot: After EU ramp: global p95=510ms, errors=0.3%, APAC still paused.

frank: Keep record: rollback playbook = `deploybot rollback --model lumen-6b-v3 --to lumen-6b-legacy-6b-v2 --reason "auto-trigger"` and manual rollback requires two eng-release approvers.

anika: Will post release-note blurb: "lumen-6b-v3: performance and stability improvements; new quant variant added to fallback ladder; pins preserved. See docs PR #501."

deploybot: Rollout complete for unpinned hosts at 2765432160. APAC remains manual. Link: https://console.redwood/rollouts/2765432101/logs

Tom: Nice work team. If any post-cutover anomalies, reply here and tag @eng-releases. :tada:
